ai.title: A first draft in seconds
ai.body: Say where you’re going and for how long. Tripvisor drafts a day-by-day plan, and you keep, swap or remove each stop before anything is saved.

route.title: A route that sorts itself
route.body: Add the places you want to see. Each day is ordered by travel time and drawn on the map, so you walk less and see more.

offline.title: Your trip, even without signal
offline.body: Plans, packing lists and expenses live on your device. Edit them anywhere, and they sync when you’re back online.
